question: After 1 November 2019 all international athletic events are being organized under the rules of _______.

options.text: The International Association of Athletic Federation

solution:
The correct answer is __**World Athletics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **World Athletics alone shall have the right to organise the Athletics competition** at the olympic games and the competitions that are included in the World athletics series. 
 
• It was **established on 17 July 1912 in Stockholm, Sweden **
